title: fix(devtools): apply serialize.reviver when parsing devtools messages
request:
fix(devtools): apply serialize.reviver when parsing devtools messages

connect() forwards `serialize` to the extension for outgoing state, but
incoming ACTION/ROLLBACK/JUMP_TO_STATE/JUMP_TO_ACTION messages were parsed
with a bare JSON.parse, so a configured reviver never ran. Types like
Immutable.js collections came back as plain objects after using devtools'
Jump/Revert/Rollback controls.
